title: Default outer query address
statement: Let $n,\ell,r$ be nonnegative integers with $n>0$, and let $V$ be a PCPP system with Boolean alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and $r$ query positions. For a seed and a query position, its outer query address is the verifier’s specified address when one is present, and otherwise is the first input coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: A PCPP system with Boolean alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and $r$ query positions
